brief:
A recently bailed activist accused of supporting Hamas denies the allegations, insisting he faces prosecution for advocating Palestinian rights rather than any genuine security threat, Al Jazeera English reported. James "Fergie" Chambers said the US government is attempting to frame antiwar ideas and pro-Palestine activism as extremism to suppress dissent.

Chambers characterized his legal troubles as retaliation for his political views. He maintained that supporting Palestine and opposing war do not constitute support for designated militant organizations, drawing a distinction between activism and the charges leveled against him.
dek: Recently bailed activist denies accusations of supporting Hamas, claiming he is being punished for supporting Palestine.
title: US labels Palestinian activist's antiwar stance as extremism, he says
